profile.name: Ivy PvE — Badlands
profile.description: Explore, survive and build your own story in a PvE-focused environment.

gameplay.title: PvE focus
gameplay.description: Server is PvE only. No PvP is allowed anywhere on the map and damage will be reflected to the player dealing it (if you shoot your friend expect to be damaged yourself and possibly die)

gameplay.title: Build & explore
gameplay.description: Explain base-building rules, persistence and raid restrictions.

gameplay.title: Custom content
gameplay.description: Introduce custom gear, vehicles, events and server-specific features.

gameplay.title: Community conduct
gameplay.description: Respect other survivors and follow the full rules.

rules.title: IVY PVE General Server Rules
rules.description:
- This server is PVE only. If you want to practise your PVP skills, please find another server.
- No refund will be given for gear lost due to bugs without video evidence.
- Any form of bullying, harassment, abuse or toxic behaviour is not welcomed.
- Loot cycling (removing and dropping/destroying unwanted loot from spawn points to make space for new loot spawn) is strictly forbidden.
- Do not dupe, hack, glitch or cheat in any form to gain an unfair advantage.
- Use vehicles at your own risk. We do not refund any vehicles.
- Do not steal from other players. If it's not yours, don't take it.
- Please use English only in global chat.
- If you come across a bodybag, leave it for the owner to retrieve their possessions.
- Please make sure your in-game name and Discord name are the same.
- Ignorance is not bliss. Rule breaking will be dealt with accordingly.

rules.title: Basebuilding Rules
rules.description:
- Building a base requires a plotpole to be placed down first.
- Do not steal from players bases.
- Base construction should be MIN 400 meters from other bases.
- One base per solo player or group.
- One base per solo player or group.
- BBP bases solo player MAX size is 3x2 in any configuration.
- BBP group MAX size is 3x3 in any configuration.
- Vanilla fence panel MAX count per base is 24.
- Vanilla panel MAX height per base is 2 panels high.MAX 2 tents per base.
- MAX 2 greenhouses per solo player, 3 greenhouses per group.
- Do not build within 500m of any military.
- Do not build at hospitals/military areas/police stations/gas stations or plank spawns.
- Do not obstruct roads or wells.
- MAX 10 Tofu barrels per solo player and +5 barrels for every extra team member (MAX 30 per group).
- Please close the lids on your Tofu barrels after use.
- Any base size breach will be deleted to maintain server performance.

rules.title: Vehicle Rules
rules.description:
- Do not take vehicles that are not yours.
- Do not take items from vehicles that don't belong to you.
- Certain traders sell select vehicles. As we all know driving in DayZ can be very unreliable, if you buy a vehicle, it is at your own risk.
- On the purchase of your new vehicle you will recieve a receipt in your inventory then follow the instructions below.
- Find a safe place in the safezone, put the receipt in your hand and left click on your mouse where you want your new vehicle to spawn in.
- When you purchase a vehicle make sure you buy a key and duplicate a spare key at the grinding wheel set at the traders and keep it safe.
- Please note, your spare keys will not sore in the Tofu barrels.
- On the purchase of your new vehicle please buy the hydraulic jack, this will assist you if you get your vehicle stuck.
- Please do not leave your vehicles parked around the map or within 500meters of traders.
- Public garages are placed around the map, PLEASE use them.
- Any unparked vehicles will despawn or get impounded. Impounded vehicles will be released for a 25% fee valued on the vehicle. Despawned vehicles will NOT be replaced.
- Do not leave your vehicle unlocked, lock it!
